description:
Activate Phyrexian Altar twice by sacrificing Sporuting Thrinax and Slimefoot and Squee, adding {1}{B}.
When Sprouting Thrinax dies, it triggers, creating three 1/1 Saproling creature tokens.
Activate Phyrexian Altar by sacrificing two Saprolings, adding {R}{G}.
Activate Slimefoot and Squee by paying {1}{B}{R}{G} and sacrificing a Saproling, returning it and Sprouting Thrinax from your graveyard to the battlefield.
When Slimefoot and Squee enter the battlefield, it triggers, creating a 1/1 Saproling creature token.
Repeat.
